proposed_component_budgets_pending_compl.rationale: Observed 420 model-pair queries in one 10-versus-10 selection/declaration. Assuming 50 such activations per game gives 21000 pair queries; at 0.5ms this estimates 10.5s of geometry within the 60s objective. The activation count is an estimate, not measured full-game evidence. A 200ms selection/declaration budget allows measured baseline variability plus correctness work. Recalibrate from repeated correct-kernel workloads without silently raising limits.
